frase_inicial: Michael: let’s go step by step and start with one small cash task

tarjetas.reverso: With the house and vacation due soon, your bank cash won’t cover those plans. That could force selling investments or pausing other goals.
tarjetas.detalle: Accessible cash today $30,000; cash target with near-term goals $163,330–$172,636.

tarjetas.frente: Retirement won’t last to your plan end
tarjetas.reverso: At your planned retirement age, savings are projected to run out earlier than you planned, so some later spending may go unpaid unless you act.
tarjetas.detalle: Savings run out at age 85; unpaid planned spending $32,439.

tarjetas.frente: Life and liability gaps need attention
tarjetas.reverso: Your current life cover and lack of extra liability protection leave your savings exposed if something happens to you or you face a large claim.
tarjetas.detalle: Life shortfall $720,000; no umbrella coverage recommended $1,000,000.

tarjetas.reverso: That card is your most expensive debt. Keeping the payment steady will pay it off in the projection, but faster payoff would free cash later.
tarjetas.detalle: Credit card balance $3,500 at 20% APR, monthly payment $200.

tarjetas.frente: You’re saving steadily — use it to choose
tarjetas.reverso: You already put money aside and capture your employer match. Now decide which matters most next: the home, boosting retirement, or protection, then we act.
tarjetas.detalle: Annual savings $43,000 including $7,000 employer match; net cash flow this year -$8,336.

movimientos.title: Add umbrella cover
movimientos.action: Add $1M of umbrella to raise the liability shield

movimientos.title: Lower the withdrawal rate
movimientos.action: Cutting withdrawals to $10,300/year (6.0%) reaches the sustainable band

movimientos.title: Raise growth allocation toward glide
movimientos.action: Move the invested mix from 74% to 88% growth (glide 98%) for the next horizon-fit band — about $19,900 of the invested book

mapa.aviso: Illustrative simulator: it shows the direction of change, not a Sherpas projection.

siguiente_paso.razon: It raises your liability shield so your savings and future plans are less exposed, and the plan lists this as a low‑effort move that improves your score.
pasos: Sit together and open the insurance app or call your current insurer
Ask about adding one million dollars of extra liability cover over your auto policy
Save the quote screenshot or note the agent’s name and cost to review next
